task.title: M1: Record the branch or tag name as the snapshot ref
task.description:
A snapshot's ref field is the literal string the user typed (HEAD, HEAD~1, a sha), so the ref picker and listSnapshots show labels like HEAD for a snapshot that is really main, and two refs at the same sha produce whichever label was typed first. Resolve a human-readable name at analysis time: the current branch for HEAD (git symbolic-ref --short HEAD, or a tag or short sha when detached), the given name for a branch or tag, and the short sha otherwise. Keep the cache keyed by sha; when an existing cache entry is a hit for a different name, refresh its ref label if the new name is more specific (a branch or tag beats HEAD or a sha).

Acceptance criteria:
- codeviz analyze on a checkout of main stores ref 'main'; codeviz analyze v0.4.1 stores 'v0.4.1'; analyze <sha> stores the 12-char short sha.
- GET /api/snapshots lists those names, and the UI's Analyzed group shows them instead of HEAD.
- A cache hit for HEAD when the entry was created as 'main' keeps 'main'.
- The analyze integration test asserts the branch name for HEAD.
